documents.abstract: Some N-sulphonylated benzimidazoles were synthesized as potential antiviral agents. Compound 16b and, to a lesser extent, 19b showed activity against two RNA viruses at micromolar concentrations.
documents.authors: Garuti L, Roberti M, Cermelli C.
documents.title: Synthesis and antiviral activity of some N-benzenesulphonylbenzimidazoles.
